summary.mechanism: No wrong-row defect exists in any of the four companies' stored standalone revenue. All four store the filing's single, undecomposed 'Revenue/Income from Operation(s)' line -- there is no sub-component (e.g. 'Sale of products' vs 'Revenue from operations') to confuse it with; each company's statement presents this as one row. The flagged gaps versus the Screener sweep are explained by two DIFFERENT site-side effects, not a defect in our data: (1) for CUPID, an intermittent Screener scrape inconsistency that in the two flagged quarters happens to read 'Total Income' (Revenue + Other Income + occasional one-off Fair Value gains) instead of Revenue from Operation, while in the control quarter (and in the flagged quarters' own comparative columns) it reads the correct row -- an unstable site artifact, confirmed unstable by checking both directions; (2) for SELMC/ESSARSHPNG/BALLARPUR, the revenue base is small (roughly Rs 1-30 crore/quarter) and Screener displays whole-crore integers, so our precise 2-decimal figure and Screener's rounded integer can differ by 5-16% in RELATIVE terms while differing by well under Rs 0.5cr in ABSOLUTE terms -- pure display-precision noise, not a row-selection error, confirmed because in several cases (SELMC) both the correct row and Total Income round to the identical Screener-displayed integer, so the flagged percentage cannot even in principle be diagnostic of which row Screener used.
